target_customer: Remote teams, creators and marketers who record screen and camera videos for messages, demos and YouTube; paid per user subscription
problem: Making polished screen and product videos takes several tools and editing skill; async video tools like Loom focus on quick messages rather than produced content.
business_model: SaaS subscription, individual and team plans

founders.name: Grant Shaddick
founders.background_notes: Product experience at eBay and Bynder per TechFundingNews (April 2025). Left his job in May 2020 to start Tella (Tella blog, Aug 2020).

founders.name: Michiel Westerbeek
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in Tella's August 2020 blog post and on the YC page.

competitors.name: Loom
competitors.what: Async screen and camera video messaging for remote teams
competitors.funding_then: Series B extension around $28.75M in May 2020, about $350M valuation (Wikipedia, press)

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser based recording and an editor with trimming, layouts and zoom was standard engineering with some hard media parts; AI editing later raised complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Many recorders exist; differentiation is polish and the combined record and edit flow, which Loom or others could copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Atlassian bought Loom for $975M in 2023; no incumbent has bought or copied Tella away; Tella continues as an independent small company.

market_need_then: Covid drove remote work and video communication in 2020; Loom's 2020 rounds showed investor and customer demand for async video.

branding.domain_note: Now uses tella.com (earlier tella.tv per help pages).

identity.visual_style: Clean, rebuilt in Framer from an agency's original direction
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and upbeat, for example High production, low effort

branding.community_and_virality: Tella never adds its own watermark to user videos, so growth is not watermark driven (help center).

brand_strength.rationale: Pleasant but generic word; no press about the brand and no watermark virality.

pivots.from: Browser based collaborative video editor for non editors (Aug 2020)
pivots.to: All in one screen recorder for messages, demos and long form video

outcome_analysis: Tella started as a collaborative browser video editor in August 2020 and became an all in one screen recorder competing with Loom. It raised only $3.5M in total, a $1.4M early round and a $2.1M seed in April 2025 led by Gradient, suggesting a lean, capital efficient business with about seven people. It has survived the Loom acquisition by Atlassian but scale and revenue are not public.
notes: The 1.4M round has no stated stage or date in the cited articles, so it is recorded as other. Total of $3.5M is stated by the CEO. Loom funding figure is from search summaries of Wikipedia and Tubefilter, and the amount differs across outlets. YC batch is Summer 2020 per Tella's own blog. Name origin and logo designer not found.
